definitions.explanation: A thin, flat television using LCD, LED, or similar panel technology, as opposed to the bulky cathode-ray-tube sets that came before.

examples.japanese: {薄型|うすがた}テレビに{買|か}い{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I replaced it with a flat-screen TV.

examples.japanese: {薄型|うすがた}テレビは{壁|かべ}にかけられる。
examples.english: A flat-screen TV can be mounted on the wall.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}の{薄型|うすがた}テレビは{画質|がしつ}がよく、{値段|ねだん}も{下|さ}がってきた。
examples.english: Recent flat-screen TVs have good picture quality, and prices have come down.

notes:
Compound of {薄型|うすがた} (thin-bodied) + テレビ (TV). Refers to modern flat-panel sets, contrasted with the older ブラウン{管|かん} cathode-ray-tube televisions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄型|うすがた}テレビを{壁|かべ}にかける: to mount a flat-screen TV on the wall
- {大型|おおがた}{薄型|うすがた}テレビ: large flat-screen TV

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {液晶|えきしょう}テレビ: LCD television — names the panel type
- {大型|おおがた}テレビ: large-screen TV — emphasizes size rather than thinness
